sentences.zh: 普屢諷多遜，令引退，多遜貪固權位，不能決。

translations.literal: Pu repeatedly hinted to Duoxun that he should withdraw; Duoxun clung greedily to his power and could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: Pu repeatedly hinted that Duoxun should withdraw from office, but Duoxun clung greedily to his power and could not bring himself to resign.

sentences.zh: 會有以多遜嘗遣堂吏趙白交通秦王廷美事聞，太宗怒，下詔數其不忠之罪，責授守兵部尚書。

translations.literal: It happened that word came that Duoxun had once sent his office clerk Zhao Bai to communicate with Prince Qin Tingmei; Taizong was angry, issued an edict enumerating his disloyal crimes, and degraded him to hold the title of minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: Word then came that Duoxun had once sent his office clerk Zhao Bai to communicate with Prince Qin, Tingmei. Taizong was furious, issued an edict enumerating his crimes of disloyalty, and degraded him to the post of minister of war.

sentences.zh: 明日，以多遜屬吏，命翰林學士承旨李昉、學士扈蒙、衛尉卿崔仁冀、膳部郎中知雜事滕中正雜治之。

translations.literal: The next day Duoxun was turned over to the judicial authorities; Li Fang, chief academician of the Hanlin Academy; Hu Meng, academician; Cui Renji, director of the Court of Imperial Regalia; and Teng Zhongzheng, director in the Ministry of Rites handling miscellaneous matters, were ordered jointly to try the case.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Duoxun was turned over to the judicial authorities. Li Fang, chief academician of the Hanlin Academy; Hu Meng, academician; Cui Renji, director of the Court of Imperial Regalia; and Teng Zhongzheng, director in the Ministry of Rites handling miscellaneous affairs, were ordered jointly to try the case.

sentences.zh: 獄具，召文武常參官集議朝堂，太子太師王溥等七十四人奏議曰：“謹案兵部尚書盧多遜，身處宰司，心懷顧望，密遣堂吏，交結親王，通達語言，咒詛君父，大逆不道，干紀亂常，上負國恩，下虧臣節，宜膏斧鉞，以正刑章。

translations.literal: When the case was complete, civil and military officials in regular attendance were summoned to gather in council in the court hall; seventy-four men including Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Wang Pu submitted a memorial stating: "We respectfully find that Lu Duoxun, Minister of War, occupying the office of chief minister yet harboring divided loyalties, secretly sent his office clerk to consort with an imperial prince, to relay words, and to curse his ruler and father—great treason, rebellion against duty, disruption of norms; he failed the state's grace above and violated the minister's integrity below. He should face the ax and halberd to rectify the law."
translations.idiomatic: When the investigation was complete, civil and military officials in regular attendance were summoned to deliberate in the court hall. Wang Pu, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and seventy-three others submitted a memorial stating: "We respectfully find that Lu Duoxun, Minister of War, though occupying high office, harbored divided loyalties, secretly sent his office clerk to consort with an imperial prince, relay messages, and curse his sovereign—an act of great treason that violates every norm of duty. He has betrayed the grace of the state above and violated the integrity owed by a minister below. He should face execution to uphold the law."

sentences.zh: 其盧多遜請依有司所斷，削奪在身官爵，準法誅斬。

translations.literal: As for Lu Duoxun, we request that in accordance with the judgment of the responsible officials his current titles be stripped and he be executed according to law.
translations.idiomatic: As for Lu Duoxun, we request that his current titles be stripped and that he be executed according to law, in accord with the judgment of the responsible officials.

sentences.zh: 秦王廷美，亦請同盧多遜處分，其所緣坐，望準律文裁遣。”

translations.literal: Prince Qin Tingmei is also requested to receive the same disposition as Lu Duoxun; those implicated through association, we hope, may be dealt with according to the statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qin Tingmei should receive the same disposition as Lu Duoxun, and those implicated through association should be dealt with according to statute, as we respectfully request.

sentences.zh: 遂下詔曰：“臣之事君，貳則有辟，下之謀上，將而必誅。

translations.literal: An edict was then issued stating: "When a minister serves his ruler, disloyalty brings punishment; when a subordinate plots against his superior, he must surely be executed."
translations.idiomatic: An edict was then issued stating: "When a minister serves his ruler, disloyalty brings punishment; when a subordinate plots against his superior, he must surely be executed."

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書盧多遜，頃自先朝擢參大政，洎予臨御，俾正台衡，職在燮調，任當輔弼。

translations.literal: Lu Duoxun, Minister of War, was recently raised from the former court to participate in great governance; when I came to rule I placed him in the highest office. His duty was to harmonize and regulate; his charge was to assist and support.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Duoxun, Minister of War, was raised from the former court to participate in great affairs of state; when I came to the throne I placed him in the highest office. His duty was to harmonize and regulate affairs; his charge was to assist and counsel me.

sentences.zh: 深負倚毗，不思補報，而乃包藏姦宄，窺伺君親，指斥乘輿，交結藩邸，大逆不道，非所宜言。

translations.literal: He deeply betrayed the trust placed in him, did not think to repay it, but instead concealed treachery, watched and waited upon ruler and kin, reviled the imperial carriage, consorted with princely households—great treason beyond what should be spoken.
translations.idiomatic: He deeply betrayed the trust placed in him and gave no thought to repaying it. Instead he concealed treachery, watched and waited upon ruler and kin, reviled the throne, and consorted with princely households—great treason beyond what words can express.

sentences.zh: 爰遣近臣，雜治其事，醜跡盡露，具獄已成，有司定刑，外廷集議，僉以梟夷其族，汙瀦其宮，用正憲章，以合經義。

translations.literal: I therefore sent close ministers jointly to try the matter; his foul deeds were fully exposed, the complete case established, the responsible officials fixed the punishment, and the outer court gathered in council—all agreed that his clan should be exterminated and his residence defiled, to rectify the law and accord with canonical principle.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore sent close ministers jointly to try the matter. His foul deeds were fully exposed, the case was complete, the responsible officials fixed the punishment, and the outer court gathered in council—all agreed that his clan should be exterminated and his residence defiled, to uphold the law and accord with canonical principle.

sentences.zh: 尚念嘗居重位，久事明廷，特寬盡室之誅，止用投荒之典，實汝有負，非我無恩。

translations.literal: Still recalling that he once held heavy office and long served a luminous court, I specially leniently waive execution of the entire household and apply only the penalty of exile to the wilderness. In truth you have failed me; it is not that I am without grace.
translations.idiomatic: Still recalling that he once held high office and long served a luminous court, I specially waive execution of the entire household and apply only the penalty of exile to the wilderness. In truth you have failed me; it is not that I am without grace.

sentences.zh: 其盧多遜在身官爵及三代封贈、妻子官封，並用削奪追毀。

translations.literal: As for Lu Duoxun's current titles and the ennoblements and posthumous honors of three generations, as well as the titles of his wife and children—all are to be stripped and revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Duoxun's current titles, the ennoblements and posthumous honors of three generations, and the titles of his wife and children are all to be stripped and revoked.

sentences.zh: 一家親屬，並配流崖州，所在馳驛發遣，縱經大赦，不在量移之限。

translations.literal: All relatives of the household are to be sent in exile to Yazhou; wherever they are, express relay is to dispatch them; even if a general amnesty passes, they are not within the limit for relocation.
translations.idiomatic: All members of his household are to be exiled to Yazhou and dispatched by express relay from wherever they are; even if a general amnesty is proclaimed, they are not eligible for transfer to a closer post.

sentences.zh: 期周已上親屬，並配隸邊遠州郡。

translations.literal: Relatives within mourning degree and above are to be assigned to distant border prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Relatives within the period-of-mourning kinship circle and above are to be assigned to remote border prefectures.

sentences.zh: 部曲奴婢縱之。

translations.literal: Retainers and slave girls are to be set free.
translations.idiomatic: His retainers and slave girls are to be set free.

sentences.zh: 餘依百官所議。

translations.literal: The rest follows what the hundred officials proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder follows the recommendation of the assembled officials.

sentences.zh: 中書吏趙白、秦王府吏閻密、王繼勳、樊德明、趙懷祿、閻懷忠並斬都門外，仍籍其家，親屬流配海島。”

translations.literal: The Secretariat clerk Zhao Bai and the Prince of Qin's house clerks Yan Mi, Wang Jixun, Fan Deming, Zhao Huailu, and Yan Huaizhong are all to be beheaded outside the capital gate; their households are still to be registered and confiscated, and relatives sent in exile to sea islands.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat clerk Zhao Bai and the Prince of Qin's house clerks Yan Mi, Wang Jixun, Fan Deming, Zhao Huailu, and Yan Huaizhong are all to be beheaded outside the capital gate; their households are to be registered and confiscated, and their relatives exiled to sea islands.

sentences.zh: 多遜至海外，因部送者還，上表稱謝。

translations.literal: Duoxun reached the overseas region; through the escort who returned he submitted a memorial expressing thanks.
translations.idiomatic: When Duoxun reached his place of exile overseas, he sent back a memorial of thanks through his escort.

sentences.zh: 雍熙二年，卒於流所，年五十二。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi he died in his place of exile, age fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxi he died in exile, at the age of fifty-two.

sentences.zh: 詔徙其家於容州，未幾，復移置荊南。

translations.literal: An edict moved his family to Rongzhou; before long they were again relocated to Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered his family moved to Rongzhou; before long they were relocated again to Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 端拱初，錄其子雍為公安主簿，還其懷州籍沒先塋。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Duangong his son Yong was recorded as chief clerk of Gong'an, and their ancestral grave at Huai prefecture confiscated in the register was restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Duangong era his son Yong was appointed chief clerk of Gong'an, and their ancestral grave at Huaizhou, which had been confiscated, was restored to the family.

sentences.zh: 雍卒，諸弟皆特敕除州縣官。

translations.literal: When Yong died, all his younger brothers were specially by edict appointed district and county officials.
translations.idiomatic: When Yong died, all his younger brothers were specially appointed to district and county posts by edict.

sentences.zh: 初，億性儉素，自奉甚薄。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yi was frugal and plain by nature and provided for himself very sparingly.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yi had been frugal and plain by nature and lived very modestly.

sentences.zh: 及多遜貴顯，賜賚優厚，服用漸侈，愀然不樂，謂親友曰：“家世儒素，一旦富貴暴至，吾未知稅駕之所。

translations.literal: When Duoxun became noble and eminent, bestowals were generous and his attire gradually grew luxurious; Yi looked unhappy and said to friends and kin: "Our family for generations has been literati and plain; suddenly wealth and honor have arrived with violence—I do not yet know where I shall alight from the carriage."
translations.idiomatic: When Duoxun rose to power and eminence, imperial gifts grew lavish and his household became increasingly extravagant. Yi looked deeply troubled and said to friends and kin: "Our family has been scholars of plain living for generations. Suddenly wealth and honor have come upon us with such force—I do not yet know where this will end for me."

sentences.zh: ”後多遜果敗，人服其識。

translations.literal: Later Duoxun indeed met ruin, and people admired his foresight.
translations.idiomatic: Later Duoxun indeed met ruin, and people admired Yi's foresight.

sentences.zh: 咸平五年，又錄雍弟寬為襄州司士參軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianping Yong's younger brother Kuan was again recorded as aide in the Judicial Section of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xianping, Yong's younger brother Kuan was again appointed aide in the Judicial Section of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 寬弟察，中景德進士，將廷試，特詔授以州掾。

translations.literal: Kuan's younger brother Cha passed the jinshi examination in the Jingde era; as he was about to take the palace examination, a special edict appointed him to a prefectural staff post.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan's younger brother Cha passed the jinshi examination in the Jingde era. As he was about to take the palace examination, a special edict appointed him to a prefectural staff post instead.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年，始改簿尉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu he was first changed to registrar or police captain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu he was first promoted to the rank of registrar or police captain.

sentences.zh: 三年，察奉多遜喪歸葬襄陽，又詔本州賜察錢三十萬。

translations.literal: In the third year Cha observed mourning for Duoxun and returned to bury him at Xiangyang; an edict again granted Cha three hundred thousand cash from the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Cha observed mourning for Duoxun and returned to bury him at Xiangyang; the court also ordered the prefecture to grant Cha three hundred thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 四年，仍錄其孫又玄為襄州司士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year his grandson Youxuan was again recorded as judicial aide of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year his grandson Youxuan was appointed judicial aide of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 宋琪，字俶寶，幽州薊人。

translations.literal: Song Qi, courtesy name Chubao, was a man of Ji in Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Song Qi, courtesy name Chubao, was a native of Ji in Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 少好學，晉祖割燕地以奉契丹，契丹歲開貢部，琪舉進士中第，署壽安王侍讀，時天福六年也。

translations.literal: In youth he loved learning. When Jin's founding ancestor ceded the Yan region to the Khitan, the Khitan opened the civil-examination circuit each year; Qi passed the jinshi examination, was appointed tutor to Prince Shou'an, at the time of the sixth year of Tianfu.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth he loved learning. After the founding emperor of the Later Jin ceded the Yan region to the Khitan, the Khitan opened the examination circuit each year. Qi passed the jinshi examination and was appointed tutor to Prince Shou'an in the sixth year of Tianfu.

sentences.zh: 幽帥趙延壽辟琪為從事，會契丹內侵，隨延壽至京師。

translations.literal: The military governor of You, Zhao Yanshou, recruited Qi as an aide; when the Khitan invaded inward, he followed Yanshou to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanshou, military governor of You, recruited Qi as a staff officer. When the Khitan invaded the heartland, Qi followed Yanshou to the capital.

sentences.zh: 延壽子讚領河中節度，漢初改授晉昌軍，皆署琪為記室。

translations.literal: Yanshou's son Zan commanded the Hezhong circuit; at the beginning of Han he was reassigned to the Jinchang army—both times he appointed Qi as recorder.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshou's son Zan commanded the Hezhong circuit and, at the founding of the Later Han, was reassigned to the Jinchang army; on both occasions he appointed Qi as recorder.

sentences.zh: 周廣順中，讚罷鎮，補觀城令。

translations.literal: In the Guangshun era of Zhou Zan left his command; Qi was appointed magistrate of Guancheng.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangshun era of the Later Zhou, when Zan left his command, Qi was appointed magistrate of Guancheng.

sentences.zh: 世宗征淮南，讚自右龍武統軍為排陣使，復辟琪從征。

translations.literal: When Shizong campaigned against Huainan, Zan went from commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army to battle-array commissioner and again recruited Qi to follow the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong campaigned against Huainan, Zan was made battle-array commissioner after serving as commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, and again recruited Qi to accompany the campaign.

sentences.zh: 及金陵歸款，以讚鎮廬州，表為觀察判官。

translations.literal: When Jinling submitted, Zan was made military governor of Luzhou; he memorialized to appoint Qi as administrative aide of the observation commission.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinling submitted, Zan was made military governor of Luzhou and had Qi appointed administrative aide of the observation commission.

sentences.zh: 部有冤獄，琪辨之，免死者三人，特加朝散大夫。

translations.literal: In the prefecture was a case of wrongful imprisonment; Qi argued it and spared three men from death; he was specially given the title of grand master of splendid happiness.
translations.idiomatic: In the prefecture there was a case of wrongful imprisonment. Qi argued the case and spared three men from execution, for which he was specially promoted to grand master of splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 讚仕宋，連移壽陽、延安二鎮，皆表為從事。

translations.literal: When Zan served Song, he was transferred in succession to the two commands of Shouyang and Yan'an; each time he memorialized to appoint Qi as aide.
translations.idiomatic: When Zan entered Song service and was transferred in succession to Shouyang and Yan'an, he each time had Qi appointed as his staff officer.

sentences.zh: 乾德四年，召拜左補闕、開封府推官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qiande he was summoned and appointed left censor and investigating officer of Kaifeng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qiande he was summoned to court and appointed left censor and investigating officer of Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太宗為府尹，初甚加禮遇，琪與宰相趙普、樞密使李崇矩善，出入門下，遂惡之，乃白太祖出琪知龍州，移閬州。

translations.literal: When Taizong was prefect of the capital, at first he greatly honored and received Qi; Qi was on good terms with chief minister Zhao Pu and commissioner of military affairs Li Chongju, going in and out of their households; therefore Taizong disliked him and reported to Taizu to send Qi out as prefect of Longzhou, then transfer him to Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong served as prefect of the capital, he initially treated Qi with great honor. But Qi was on close terms with Chief Minister Zhao Pu and Commissioner of Military Affairs Li Chongju, visiting their households freely, and Taizong came to dislike him. He reported this to Taizu, who sent Qi out as prefect of Longzhou and then transferred him to Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 開寶九年，為護國軍節度判官。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kaibao he was administrative aide of the Huguo army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Kaibao he served as administrative aide of the Huguo army circuit.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，召赴闕。

translations.literal: When Taizong acceded to the throne, Qi was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong ascended the throne, Qi was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 時程羽、賈琰皆自府邸攀附致顯要，抑琪久不得調。

translations.literal: At the time Cheng Yu and Jia Yan had all clung to the prince's household and reached high rank; Qi was held down and long went without promotion.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Cheng Yu and Jia Yan had risen to prominence by attaching themselves to Taizong's princely household, while Qi was held back and long went without promotion.

sentences.zh: 太平興國三年，授太子洗馬，召見詰責，琪拜謝，請悔過自新。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo he was given the title of groom of the heir apparent's horses; summoned for audience and rebuked, Qi bowed in apology and requested to repent and renew himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo he was appointed groom of the heir apparent's horses. When summoned and rebuked by the emperor, Qi bowed in apology and pledged to repent and reform.

sentences.zh: 遷太常丞，出知大通監。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and sent out as supervisor of Datong.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and sent out as supervisor of the Datong Commission.

sentences.zh: 五年，召歸，將加擢用，為盧多遜所沮，改都官郎中，出知廣州，將行，復以藩邸舊僚留判三司勾院。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was recalled; as he was about to be promoted and employed, Lu Duoxun obstructed it; he was changed to director in the Ministry of Justice, sent out as prefect of Guangzhou; as he was about to depart, because he was an old associate of the princely household he was retained to serve as assistant judge of the Three Departments audit commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was recalled and was about to be promoted when Lu Duoxun blocked it. He was reassigned as director in the Ministry of Justice and sent out as prefect of Guangzhou, but as he was about to depart he was retained as assistant judge of the Three Departments audit commission because he was an old associate of Taizong's princely household.

sentences.zh: 七年，與三司使王仁贍廷辯事忤旨，責授兵部員外郎，俄通判開封府事，京府置通判自琪始。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, disputing with Three Departments commissioner Wang Renzan in court and offending the imperial will, he was degraded to vice director in the Ministry of War; soon he served as co-administrator of Kaifeng prefecture affairs—the capital prefecture's establishment of a co-administrator began with Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he debated policy with Three Departments Commissioner Wang Renzan in court and offended the emperor, and was demoted to vice director in the Ministry of War. Soon afterward he became co-administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture—the capital's first such post was created for Qi.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月，擢拜右諫議大夫、同判三司。

translations.literal: In the first month of the spring of the eighth year he was elevated and appointed right remonstrance-advisor and co-administrator of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year he was elevated to right remonstrance-advisor and co-administrator of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 三月，改左諫議大夫、參知政事。

translations.literal: In the third month he was changed to left remonstrance-advisor and participant in governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was appointed left remonstrance-advisor and participant in governance.

sentences.zh: 是秋，上將以工部尚書李昉參預國政，以琪先入，乃遷琪為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: That autumn the emperor was about to have Li Fang, Minister of Works, participate in state affairs; because Qi had entered first, Qi was transferred to Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the emperor planned to bring Li Fang, Minister of Works, into national governance. Because Qi had entered first, Qi was transferred to Minister of Punishments instead.

sentences.zh: 十月，趙普出鎮南陽，琪遂與昉同拜平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Zhao Pu went out to command Nanyang; Qi then with Fang together received appointment as grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zhao Pu was sent out to command Nanyang, and Qi and Li Fang were jointly appointed grand councilors.

sentences.zh: 自員外郎歲中四遷至尚書為相。

translations.literal: From vice director he was four times transferred within the year to minister and became chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Within a single year he rose four ranks from vice director to minister and became chief minister.

sentences.zh: 上謂曰：“世之治亂，在賞當其功，罰當其罪，即無不治；

translations.literal: The emperor said to him: "Order and disorder in the world depend on rewarding according to merit and punishing according to guilt—then there is none that is not governed;"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to him: "Order and disorder in the world depend on rewarding according to merit and punishing according to guilt—then there is none that is not governed;"

sentences.zh: 謂為飾喜怒之具，即無不亂，卿等慎之。”

translations.literal: if they are taken as instruments for embellishing one's likes and dislikes, then there is none that is not in disorder—be careful of this, all of you."
translations.idiomatic: if they are taken as instruments for embellishing one's likes and dislikes, then there is none that is not in disorder—be careful of this, all of you."

sentences.zh: 九年九月，上幸景龍門外觀水磑，因謂侍臣曰：“此水出於山源，清冷甘美，凡近河水味皆甘，豈非餘潤之所及乎？

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the ninth year the emperor visited the water mill outside Jinglong Gate and said to his attending ministers: "This water comes from a mountain spring—clear, cold, sweet, and fine. Every nearby stretch of river water is sweet as well—could this not be due to the lingering nourishment it provides?"
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the ninth year the emperor visited the water mill outside Jinglong Gate and said to his attending ministers: "This water comes from a mountain spring—clear, cold, sweet, and fine. Every nearby stretch of river water is sweet as well—could this not be due to the lingering nourishment it provides?"

sentences.zh: ”琪等對曰：“實由地脈潛通而然，亦猶人之善惡以染習而成也。

translations.literal: Qi and the others replied: "In truth it is because underground veins connect in secret—just as people's good and evil are formed through habit and influence."
translations.idiomatic: Qi and the others replied: "In truth it is because underground veins connect in secret—just as people's good and evil are formed through habit and influence."

sentences.zh: ”其年冬，郊祀禮畢，加門下侍郎、昭文館大學士。

translations.literal: That winter, when the suburban sacrifice was complete, he was given the additional titles of vice director of the Chancellery and grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, after the suburban sacrifice was complete, he was given the additional titles of vice director of the Chancellery and grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall.

sentences.zh: 一日，上謂琪等曰：“在昔帝王多以崇高自處，顏色嚴毅，左右無敢質言者。

translations.literal: One day the emperor said to Qi and the others: "In the past emperors and kings often placed themselves on high, with stern countenance and severity, and those at their side did not dare speak plainly."
translations.idiomatic: One day the emperor said to Qi and the others: "In the past emperors and kings often placed themselves on high, with stern countenance and severity, and those at their side did not dare speak plainly."

sentences.zh: 朕與卿等周旋款曲，商榷時事，蓋欲通上下之情，無有壅蔽。

translations.literal: I with all of you move to and fro in warm familiarity, consulting on affairs of the time—this is precisely to open communication between above and below, without blockage or concealment.
translations.idiomatic: I move among all of you in warm familiarity, consulting on affairs of the time—this is precisely to open communication between above and below, without blockage or concealment.

sentences.zh: 卿等但直道而行，無得有所顧避。

translations.literal: All of you need only walk the straight path—do not hold back through concern or avoidance.
translations.idiomatic: All of you need only walk the straight path—do not hold back through concern or avoidance.

sentences.zh: ”琪謝曰：“臣等非才，待罪相府，陛下曲賜溫顏，令盡愚懇，敢不傾竭以副聖意。

translations.literal: Qi thanked him and said: "We your ministers lack talent and hold office in the chief minister's hall at fault; Your Majesty has graciously bestowed a warm countenance and ordered us to speak our plain sincerity—we dare not fail to pour out all we have to fulfill the sacred will."
translations.idiomatic: Qi thanked him and said: "We your ministers lack talent and hold office in the chief minister's hall at fault; Your Majesty has graciously bestowed a warm countenance and ordered us to speak our plain sincerity—we dare not fail to pour out all we have to fulfill the sacred will."

sentences.zh: ”會詔廣宮城，宣徽使柴禹錫有別第在表識內，上言願易官邸，上覽奏不悅。

translations.literal: It happened that an edict expanded the palace city; Palace Provision commissioner Chai Yuxi had a separate residence within the marked boundary; he submitted a memorial wishing to exchange it for an official residence; when the emperor read the memorial he was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that an edict expanded the palace city. Palace Provision Commissioner Chai Yuxi had a separate residence within the marked boundary and submitted a memorial wishing to exchange it for an official residence; when the emperor read the memorial he was displeased.

sentences.zh: 禹錫陰結琪，欲因白請盧多遜舊第，上益鄙之。

translations.literal: Yuxi secretly aligned with Qi, wishing to take advantage of reporting to request Lu Duoxun's old residence; the emperor grew even more contemptuous.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi secretly enlisted Qi's help, hoping to use him to request Lu Duoxun's former residence; the emperor grew even more contemptuous of them both.

sentences.zh: 先是，簡州軍事推官王澣引對，上嘉其雋爽，面授朝官。

translations.literal: Earlier, Jianzhou military-affairs investigating officer Wang Huan was brought for audience; the emperor admired his keen forthrightness and personally assigned him a court office on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Wang Huan, military-affairs investigating officer of Jianzhou, was brought for audience. The emperor admired his keen forthrightness and personally assigned him a court office on the spot.

sentences.zh: 翼日，琪奏澣經學出身，一任幕職，例除七寺丞。

translations.literal: The next day Qi memorialized that Huan came from a background in classical learning, had held one term of staff service, and by precedent should be appointed to a seventh-office assistant directorship.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Qi memorialized that Huan, having come from a background in classical learning and served one term on a staff, should by precedent be appointed to an assistant directorship in one of the seven temples.

sentences.zh: 上曰：“吾已許之矣，可與東宮官。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I have already promised him—it may be an eastern-palace office."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "I have already promised him—it may be an eastern-palace office."

sentences.zh: ”琪執不從，擬大理丞告牒進入，上批曰：“可右讚善大夫。

translations.literal: Qi obstinately would not comply and drafted the appointment notice as grand court direct clerk for submission; the emperor wrote in the margin: "He may be right aide to the heir apparent."
translations.idiomatic: Qi obstinately would not comply and drafted the appointment notice as grand court direct clerk for submission; the emperor wrote in the margin: "He may be right aide to the heir apparent."

sentences.zh: ”琪勉從命，上滋不悅。

translations.literal: Qi reluctantly obeyed; the emperor grew ever more displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Qi reluctantly obeyed, and the emperor grew still more displeased.

sentences.zh: 初，上令琪娶馬仁瑀寡妻高繼冲之女，厚加賜與以助采。

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor had Qi marry the daughter of Gao Jichong, widow of Ma Renyu, and richly bestowed gifts to assist with betrothal.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the emperor had arranged for Qi to marry the daughter of Gao Jichong, widow of Ma Renyu, and had richly bestowed gifts to assist with the betrothal.

sentences.zh: 廣南轉運王延範，高氏之親也，知廣州徐休復密奏其不軌，且言其依附大臣。

translations.literal: Wang Yanfan, transport commissioner of Guangnan, was a kinsman of the Gao clan; Xu Xiufu, prefect of Guangzhou, secretly memorialized that Yanfan was disloyal and moreover said he relied on great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanfan, transport commissioner for Guangnan, was a kinsman of the Gao family. Xu Xiufu, prefect of Guangzhou, secretly memorialized that Yanfan was plotting treason and that he relied on powerful ministers for support.

sentences.zh: 上因琪與禹錫入對，問延範何如人，琪未知其端，盛言延範強明忠幹，禹錫旁奏與琪同。

translations.literal: The emperor took advantage of Qi and Yuxi entering for audience and asked what sort of man Yanfan was; Qi did not know the background and lavishly praised Yanfan as forceful, clear, loyal, and capable; Yuxi memorialized from the side in agreement with Qi.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi and Yuxi came before the emperor, he asked them what sort of man Yanfan was. Unaware of the background, Qi lavishly praised Yanfan as forceful, capable, loyal, and diligent, while Yuxi chimed in from the side in agreement.

sentences.zh: 上意琪交通，不欲暴其狀，因以琪素好詼諧，無大臣體，罷守本官；

translations.literal: The emperor suspected Qi of illicit association and did not wish to expose the details; he therefore took Qi as always fond of wit and jest and lacking the bearing of a great minister, and removed him while retaining his original office;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected Qi of collusion but did not wish to expose the details openly. Instead he cited Qi's fondness for wit and jest and lack of the bearing befitting a chief minister, and dismissed him from his grand councilor's post while retaining his original rank;

sentences.zh: 禹錫授左驍衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Yuxi was appointed general of the Left Martial Majestic Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi was appointed general of the Left Martial Majestic Guard.

sentences.zh: 琪將罷前數日，有異鳥集琪待漏之所，驅之不去，及是罷相，人以為先兆云。

translations.literal: Several days before Qi's dismissal a strange bird settled at Qi's waiting-for-the-audience hall; driven away it would not leave; when at this point he was dismissed as chief minister, people regarded it as an omen.
translations.idiomatic: Several days before Qi's dismissal a strange bird alighted at the hall where he waited for court audience and would not leave even when driven away. When he was dismissed as chief minister, people took this as an omen.

sentences.zh: 端拱初，上親耕籍田，以舊相進位吏部尚書。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Duangong the emperor personally plowed the sacred field; as a former chief minister Qi was advanced to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Duangong era the emperor personally plowed the sacred field, and Qi, as a former chief minister, was promoted to Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二年，將討幽薊，詔群臣各言邊事。

translations.literal: In the second year, as a campaign against You and Ji was planned, an edict ordered the hundred officials each to speak on border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, as the court prepared to campaign against You and Ji, an edict ordered all officials to submit their views on border affairs.

sentences.zh: 琪上疏謂：

translations.literal: Qi submitted a memorial stating:
translations.idiomatic: Qi submitted a memorial stating:

sentences.zh: “大舉精甲，以事討除，靈旗所指，燕城必降。

translations.literal: "Raise elite armored troops in great force to undertake punitive elimination; wherever the spirit banner points, the city of Yan will surely surrender.
translations.idiomatic: "Raise elite armored troops in great force to undertake punitive elimination; wherever the spirit banner points, the city of Yan will surely surrender.

sentences.zh: 但徑路所趨，不無險易，必若取雄、霸路直進，未免更有陽城之圍。

translations.literal: But the route one takes is not without difficult and easy stretches; if one takes the Xiong and Ba route and pushes straight ahead, one cannot avoid another siege like that at Yangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: But whichever route one takes, there are difficult stretches as well as easy ones; if one takes the Xiong and Ba route and pushes straight ahead, one cannot avoid another siege like that at Yangcheng.

sentences.zh: 蓋界河之北，陂澱坦平，北路行師，非我所便。

translations.literal: For north of the Border River the marshes and lakes are flat and level; marching an army by the northern route is not to our advantage.
translations.idiomatic: North of the Border River the marshes and lakes lie flat and open; marching an army by the northern route is not to our advantage.

sentences.zh: 況軍行不離於輜重，賊來莫測其淺深。

translations.literal: Moreover, the army on the march cannot leave its baggage train behind; when the enemy comes, one cannot gauge whether the water is shallow or deep.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, an army on the march cannot leave its baggage train behind, and when the enemy strikes one cannot tell whether the water is shallow or deep.

sentences.zh: 欲望回轅，西適山路，令大軍會於易州，循孤山之北，漆水以西，挾山而行，援糧而進，涉涿水，並大房，抵桑幹河，出安祖砦，則東瞰燕城，裁及一舍，此是周德威收燕之路。

translations.literal: I wish to turn the chariots about and go west by the mountain road, have the great army assemble at Yizhou, follow north of Mount Gu and west of the Qi River, march along the mountains while bringing up supplies, cross the Zhuo River, go alongside Dafang, reach the Sanggan River, and emerge at Anzu Fort—then looking east one overlooks the city of Yan, only about ten li away. This is the route by which Zhou Dewei recovered Yan.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to turn the chariots about and go west by the mountain road, have the main army assemble at Yizhou, follow north of Mount Gu and west of the Qi River, march along the mountains while bringing up supplies, cross the Zhuo River, pass alongside Dafang, reach the Sanggan River, and emerge at Anzu Fort—then, looking east, one overlooks the city of Yan, barely ten li away. This is the route by which Zhou Dewei recovered Yan.

sentences.zh: 自易水距此二百餘里，並是沿山，村墅連延，溪澗相接，采薪汲水，我占上游。

translations.literal: From the Yi River to here is more than two hundred li, all along the mountains; villages and manor houses stretch in succession and streams and ravines connect; for gathering firewood and drawing water, we hold the upper reaches.
translations.idiomatic: From the Yi River to this point is more than two hundred li, all along the mountains; villages and manor houses stretch in succession and streams and ravines run together. For gathering firewood and drawing water, we would hold the upper reaches.

sentences.zh: 東則林麓平岡，非戎馬奔衝之地，內排槍弩步隊，實王師備禦之方，而於山上列白幟以望之，戎馬之來，二十里外可悉數也。

translations.literal: To the east are forested foothills and level ridges—not ground for barbarian horses to charge; deploy pike-and-crossbow foot units within as the imperial army's method of defense, and on the mountains array white banners to watch; when barbarian horses come, they can be counted in full from twenty li away.
translations.idiomatic: To the east lie forested foothills and level ridges—not ground where barbarian horses can charge freely. Deploy pike-and-crossbow infantry within as the imperial army's method of defense, and on the mountains array white banners to watch; when barbarian horses approach, they can be counted in full from twenty li away.

sentences.zh: 從安祖砦西北有盧師神祠，是桑幹出山之口，東及幽州四十餘里。

translations.literal: Northwest from Anzu Fort is the shrine of the Lu Division Spirit—it is the mouth where the Sanggan emerges from the mountains, east to Youzhou more than forty li.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest from Anzu Fort stands the shrine of the Lu Division Spirit—the place where the Sanggan River emerges from the mountains, more than forty li east to Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 趙德鈞作鎮之時，欲遏西衝，曾塹此水。

translations.literal: When Zhao Dejun held the commandery, wishing to block the western thrust, he once ditched this river.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Dejun held the commandery, wishing to block the western thrust, he once dug ditches across this river.

sentences.zh: 況河次半有崖岸，不可徑度，其平處築城護之，守以偏師，此斷彼之右臂也。

translations.literal: Moreover, halfway along the river there are cliff banks and one cannot ford directly; at the flat places build a fort to protect it and garrison with a detached force—this cuts off their right arm.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, halfway along the river there are cliff banks and one cannot ford directly; at the level stretches build a fort to guard it and hold it with a detached force—this cuts off their right arm.

sentences.zh: 仍慮步奚為寇，可分雄勇兵士三五千人，至青白軍以來山中防遏，北是新州、媯川之間，南出易州大路，其桑幹河水屬燕城北隅，繞西壁而轉。

translations.literal: Still fearing that the Xi might raid as bandits, one may divide three to five thousand elite brave soldiers to defend and block in the mountains from Qingbai Army onward—north is between Xinzhou and Guichuan, south exits by the main road to Yizhou. The Sanggan River water belongs to the northwest corner of Yan city, winding around the western wall.
translations.idiomatic: Still fearing that the Xi might raid as bandits, one may detach three to five thousand elite troops to defend and block in the mountains from Qingbai Army onward—north lies the country between Xinzhou and Guichuan, and southward the main road to Yizhou opens out. The Sanggan River water belongs to the northwest corner of Yan city and winds around the western wall.

sentences.zh: 大軍如至城下，於燕丹陵東北橫堰此水，灌入高梁河，高梁岸狹，桑水必溢。

translations.literal: When the great army reaches below the city, dam this water northeast of Yan Dan's tomb horizontally and divert it into the Gaoliang River—the Gaoliang banks are narrow and the Sanggan water will surely overflow.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army reaches below the city, dam this water northeast of Yan Dan's tomb and divert it into the Gaoliang River—the Gaoliang banks are narrow, and the Sanggan water will surely overflow.

sentences.zh: 可於駐掞寺東引入郊亭澱，三五日瀰漫百餘里，即幽州隔在水南。

translations.literal: One may lead it east of Zhushan Temple into the Jiaoting Marsh; in three to five days it will spread over more than a hundred li, and Youzhou will be cut off south of the water.
translations.idiomatic: One may lead it east of Zhushan Temple into the Jiaoting Marsh; in three to five days it will spread over more than a hundred li, and Youzhou will stand cut off south of the water.

sentences.zh: 王師可於州北係浮梁以通北路，賊騎來援，已隔水矣。

translations.literal: The imperial army may moor floating bridges north of the prefecture to connect the northern route; when the enemy's cavalry come to aid, they will already be cut off by water.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial army may moor floating bridges north of the prefecture to open the northern route; when the enemy's cavalry come to relieve the city, they will already be cut off by water.

sentences.zh: 視此孤壘，浹旬必克。

translations.literal: Viewing this isolated fortress, within ten days it will surely be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Given this isolated fortress, within ten days it will surely be taken.

sentences.zh: 幽州管內洎山後八軍，聞薊門不守，必盡歸降，蓋勢使然也。

translations.literal: Within the jurisdiction of Youzhou and the eight garrisons behind the mountains, when they hear that Jie Gate is not held, they will surely all return and surrender—for such is the force of circumstance.
translations.idiomatic: Within Youzhou's jurisdiction and the eight garrisons behind the mountains, when they hear that Jie Gate is not held, they will surely all return and surrender—for such is the force of circumstance.

sentences.zh: 然後國家命重臣以鎮之，敷恩澤以懷之。

translations.literal: After that the state should appoint a heavy minister to garrison there and spread benevolent favor to win them over.
translations.idiomatic: After that the state should appoint a senior minister to garrison the region and spread benevolent favor to win the people over.

sentences.zh: 奚、霫部落，當劉仁恭及其男守光之時，皆刺面為義兒，服燕軍指使，人馬疆土少劣於契丹，自被脅從役屬以來，常懷骨髓之恨。

translations.literal: The Xi and Hui tribes—when Liu Rengong and his son Shouguang held power, all had their faces tattooed as sworn sons and obeyed the commands of the Yan army; their men, horses, and territory were somewhat inferior to the Khitan; since being coerced into service and subordination they have constantly harbored hatred to the marrow of their bones.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi and Hui tribes—when Liu Rengong and his son Shouguang held power, all had their faces tattooed as sworn sons and obeyed the Yan army's commands; their men, horses, and territory were somewhat inferior to the Khitan's; and since being coerced into service and subordination they have constantly harbored hatred to the marrow of their bones.

sentences.zh: 渤海兵馬土地，盛於奚帳，雖勉事契丹，俱懷殺主破國之怨。

translations.literal: The Bohai people's horses, troops, and territory exceed the Xi camps; although they serve the Khitan under compulsion, all harbor resentment at having their lord killed and their state destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The Bohai in horses, troops, and territory surpass the Xi camps; although they serve the Khitan under compulsion, all harbor the resentment of a lord slain and a state destroyed.

sentences.zh: 其薊門洎山後雲、朔等州，沙陀、吐渾元是割屬，咸非叛黨。

translations.literal: Jie Gate and the Yun and Shuo prefectures behind the mountains—the Shatuo and Tuyuhun were originally allotted territories and none are truly rebel factions.
translations.idiomatic: As for Jie Gate and the Yun and Shuo prefectures behind the mountains, the Shatuo and Tuyuhun were originally allotted territories, and none are truly rebel factions.

sentences.zh: 此蕃漢諸部之眾，如將來王師討伐，雖臨陣擒獲，必貸其死，命署置存撫，使之懷恩，但以罪契丹為名。

translations.literal: These masses of the various Han and barbarian tribes—if in the future the imperial army campaigns in punitive attack, even if captured in battle, their lives must be spared and they must be appointed and reassured to make them feel gratitude, but only in the name of punishing the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: These masses among the Han and barbarian tribes—if in the future the imperial army campaigns in punitive attack, even those captured in battle must be spared, appointed, and reassured so that they feel gratitude, but only in the name of punishing the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 如此則蕃部之心，願報私憾，契丹小醜，克日殄平。

translations.literal: In this way the hearts of the barbarian tribes, wishing to repay private grudges, and the Khitan petty rabble will be destroyed and pacified within days.
translations.idiomatic: In this way the hearts of the barbarian tribes, eager to repay private grudges, will turn against the Khitan rabble, and they will be destroyed and pacified within days.

sentences.zh: 其奚、霫、渤海之國，各選重望親嫡，封冊為王，仍賜分器、鼓旗、軍服、戈甲以優遣之，必竭赤心，永服皇化。

translations.literal: For the states of Xi, Hui, and Bohai, each select persons of heavy reputation who are close kin, enfeoff and appoint them as kings, and moreover bestow ritual vessels, drums and banners, military dress, spears and armor to send them off with honor—they will surely pour out their loyal hearts and forever submit to imperial transformation.
translations.idiomatic: For the states of Xi, Hui, and Bohai, each select men of high standing who are close kin, enfeoff them as kings, and moreover bestow ritual vessels, drums and banners, military dress, spears and armor to send them off with honor—they will surely pour out their loyal hearts and forever submit to imperial civilization.

sentences.zh: 俟克平之後，宣布守臣，令於燕境及山後雲、朔諸州，厚給衣糧料錢，別作禁軍名額，召募三五萬人，教以騎射，隸於本州。

translations.literal: After pacification is complete, proclaim garrison commanders and order them in Yan territory and the Yun and Shuo prefectures behind the mountains to richly supply clothing, grain, and stipend funds, separately establish forbidden-army roster names, recruit thirty to fifty thousand men, teach them mounted archery, and assign them to their prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: After pacification is complete, proclaim garrison commanders and order them in Yan territory and the Yun and Shuo prefectures behind the mountains to richly supply clothing, grain, and stipend funds, separately establish forbidden-army roster names, recruit thirty to fifty thousand men, teach them mounted archery, and assign them to their home prefectures.

sentences.zh: 此人生長塞垣，諳練戎事，乘機戰鬥，一以當十，兼得奚、霫、渤海以為外臣，乃守在四夷也。

translations.literal: These people grew up on the frontier and are skilled in barbarian affairs; fighting when opportunity arises one man can match ten; moreover gaining the Xi, Hui, and Bohai as outer vassals—this is defending by keeping the four barbarians at bay.
translations.idiomatic: These people grew up on the frontier and are skilled in barbarian warfare; when they fight at the right moment one man can match ten. Moreover, with the Xi, Hui, and Bohai as outer vassals, this is what it means to hold the frontier against the four barbarians.

sentences.zh: 然自阿保機時至於近日，河朔戶口，虜掠極多，並在錦帳。

translations.literal: Yet from Abaoji's time until recently, the population of the Hebei region has been plundered in extremely great numbers, all now in the brocade tents.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from Abaoji's time until recently, the population of the Hebei region has been plundered in vast numbers, all of them now living in the brocade tents.

sentences.zh: 平盧亦邇柳城，遼海編戶數十萬餘，耕墾千餘里，既殄異類，悉為王民。

translations.literal: Pinglu also borders Liucheng; the Liaodong registered households number several hundred thousand, with cultivation extending more than a thousand li; once the alien peoples are destroyed, all will become the king's subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Pinglu also borders Liucheng; the Liaodong registered households number several hundred thousand, with cultivation extending more than a thousand li. Once the alien peoples are destroyed, all will become the king's subjects.

sentences.zh: 變其衣冠，被以聲教，願歸者俾復舊貫，懷安者因而撫之，申畫郊圻，列為州縣，則前代所建松漠、饒落等郡，未為開拓之盛也。”

translations.literal: Change their dress, clothe them in civilizing instruction; those who wish to return let them resume their old customs, those who find contentment comfort them accordingly; demarcate the outer marches and establish them as prefectures and counties—then the Songmo and Raoluo commanderies established in former ages will not compare with the glory of this opening of the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Change their dress and clothe them in civilizing instruction; let those who wish to return resume their old ways, and comfort those who find contentment where they are; demarcate the outer marches and establish prefectures and counties—then the Songmo and Raoluo commanderies established in former ages will not compare with the glory of this frontier opening.

sentences.zh: 琪本燕人，以故究知蕃部兵馬山川形勢。

translations.literal: Qi was originally a man of Yan, and for that reason thoroughly knew the barbarian tribes' troops, horses, mountains, rivers, and terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Qi was originally a man of Yan and for that reason had thorough knowledge of the barbarian tribes' troops, horses, mountains, rivers, and terrain.

sentences.zh: 俄又上奏曰：

translations.literal: Soon he submitted again, stating:
translations.idiomatic: Soon he submitted again, stating:

sentences.zh: “國家將平燕薊，臣敢陳十策：一、契丹種族，二、料賊眾寡，三、賊來布置，四、備邊，五、命將，六、排陣討伐，七、和蕃，八、饋運，九、收幽州，十、滅契丹。

translations.literal: "As the state prepares to pacify Yan and Ji, your subject dares to set forth ten strategies: one, the Khitan race; two, estimating the enemy's numbers; three, the enemy's disposition on coming; four, border defense; five, appointing generals; six, deploying formations for punitive attack; seven, harmonizing with the barbarians; eight, supply transport; nine, recovering Youzhou; ten, destroying the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: "As the state prepares to pacify Yan and Ji, your subject dares to set forth ten strategies: one, the Khitan race; two, estimating the enemy's strength; three, the enemy's disposition on coming south; four, border defense; five, appointing generals; six, deploying formations for punitive attack; seven, harmonizing with the barbarians; eight, supply transport; nine, recovering Youzhou; ten, destroying the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 契丹，蕃部之別種，代居遼澤中，南界潢水，西距邢山，疆土幅員，千里而近。

translations.literal: The Khitan are a separate branch of the barbarian tribes, generation after generation dwelling in the Liao marshes, bounded south by the Huang River and west by Xing Mountain, their territory extending nearly a thousand li in circumference.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan are a separate branch of the barbarian tribes, dwelling generation after generation in the Liao marshes, bounded south by the Huang River and west by Xing Mountain, with a territory nearly a thousand li across.

sentences.zh: 其主自阿保機始強盛，因攻渤海，死於遼陽。

translations.literal: Their ruler from the time of Abaoji became powerful; he attacked Bohai and died at Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Their ruler grew powerful beginning with Abaoji; he attacked Bohai and died at Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 妻述律氏生三男：長曰東丹；

translations.literal: His wife Empress Shulü bore three sons: the eldest was Eastern Dan;
translations.idiomatic: His wife Empress Shulü bore three sons: the eldest was Eastern Dan;

sentences.zh: 次曰德光，德光南侵還，死於殺胡林；

translations.literal: the second was Deguang; Deguang returned from a southern invasion and died at Shahu Grove;
translations.idiomatic: the second was Deguang; Deguang returned from a southern invasion and died at Shahu Grove;

sentences.zh: 季曰自在太子。

translations.literal: the third was the Self-Existent Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: the third was the Self-Existent Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 東丹生永康，永康代德光為主，謀起軍南侵，被殺於火神澱。

translations.literal: Eastern Dan begot Yongkang; Yongkang succeeded Deguang as ruler, plotted to raise an army for southern invasion, and was killed at the Huoshen Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Dan begot Yongkang; Yongkang succeeded Deguang as ruler, plotted to raise an army for a southern invasion, and was killed at the Huoshen Marsh.

sentences.zh: 德光之子述律代立，號為“睡王”。

translations.literal: Deguang's son Shulü succeeded to the throne and was styled the "Sleeping King."
translations.idiomatic: Deguang's son Shulü succeeded to the throne and was styled the "Sleeping King."

sentences.zh: 二年，為永康子明記所篡。

translations.literal: In the second year he was usurped by Yongkang's son Mingji.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was usurped by Yongkang's son Mingji.

sentences.zh: 明記死，幼主代立。

translations.literal: When Mingji died, a young ruler succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingji died, a young ruler succeeded to the throne.

sentences.zh: 明記妻蕭氏，蕃將守興之女，今幼主，蕭氏所生也。

translations.literal: Mingji's wife was of the Xiao clan, daughter of the barbarian general Shouxing; the present young ruler was born of Lady Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: Mingji's wife was of the Xiao clan, daughter of the barbarian general Shouxing; the present young ruler was born of Lady Xiao.

sentences.zh: 晉末，契丹主頭下兵謂之大帳，有皮室兵約三萬，皆精甲也，為其爪牙。

translations.literal: At the end of Jin, the troops under the Khitan ruler's personal banner were called the Great Tent, with about thirty thousand Pishi troops, all elite armor, serving as his claws and fangs.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Jin dynasty, the troops under the Khitan ruler's personal banner were called the Great Tent, with about thirty thousand Pishi troops—all elite armor—serving as his claws and fangs.

sentences.zh: 國母述律氏頭下，謂之屬珊，屬珊有眾二萬，乃阿保機之牙將，當是時半已老矣。

translations.literal: Under the queen mother Shulü's personal banner were the so-called Shushan, with twenty thousand troops—they were Abaoji's personal guards; by this time half were already old.
translations.idiomatic: Under the queen mother Shulü's personal banner were the so-called Shushan, with twenty thousand troops—they were Abaoji's personal guards, and by this time half were already old.

sentences.zh: 南來時，量分借得三五千騎，述律常留餘兵為部族根本。

translations.literal: When coming south, they would borrow only three to five thousand horsemen on estimate; Shulü always kept the remaining troops as the tribal foundation.
translations.idiomatic: When coming south, they would borrow only an estimated three to five thousand horsemen; Shulü always kept the remaining troops as the tribal foundation.

sentences.zh: 其諸大首領有太子、偉王、永康、南北王、於越、麻答、五押等。

translations.literal: Among the various great chiefs are the crown prince, the Worthy King, Yongkang, the Southern and Northern Kings, the Yuyue, Madar, and the Five Yash.
translations.idiomatic: Among the various great chiefs are the crown prince, the Worthy King, Yongkang, the Southern and Northern Kings, the Yuyue, Madar, and the Five Yash.

sentences.zh: 於越，謂其國舅也。

translations.literal: Yuyue means the king's maternal uncle by marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Yuyue means the king's maternal uncle by marriage.

sentences.zh: 大者千餘騎，次者數百騎，皆私甲也。

translations.literal: The great ones have more than a thousand horsemen, the lesser several hundred—all private retainers.
translations.idiomatic: The great ones have more than a thousand horsemen, the lesser several hundred—all private retainers.

sentences.zh: 別族則有奚、霫，勝兵亦萬餘人，少馬多步。

translations.literal: Separate tribes include the Xi and Hui, with able warriors also exceeding ten thousand, few horses and mostly infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Separate tribes include the Xi and Hui, with able warriors also exceeding ten thousand—few horses and mostly infantry.

sentences.zh: 奚，其王名阿保得者，昔年犯闕時，令送劉希、崔廷勳屯河、洛者也。

translations.literal: The Xi—their king named Abade—when in former years they violated the capital, was the one who sent Liu Xi and Cui Tingxun to garrison the Yellow and Luo rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi—their king named Abade—when in former years they violated the capital, was the one who sent Liu Xi and Cui Tingxun to garrison the Yellow and Luo rivers.

sentences.zh: 又有渤海首領大舍利高模翰步騎萬餘人，並髡髮左衽，竊為契丹之飾。

translations.literal: There is also the Bohai chief Great Sheli Gao Mohan with more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry, all with shaved heads and left-lapped collars, secretly adopting Khitan dress.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Bohai chief Great Sheli Gao Mohan with more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry, all with shaved heads and left-lapped collars, secretly adopting Khitan dress.

sentences.zh: 復有近界尉厥黒、室韋、女真、党項亦被脅屬，每部不過千餘騎。

translations.literal: Also near the border Yuquehei, Shiwei, Jurchen, and Tangut have likewise been coerced into submission, each tribe not exceeding a thousand-plus horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Also near the border, Yuquehei, Shiwei, Jurchen, and Tangut have likewise been coerced into submission, each tribe fielding no more than a thousand-odd horsemen.

sentences.zh: 其三部落，吐渾、沙陀，洎幽州管內、雁門已北十餘州軍部落漢兵合二萬餘眾，此是石晉割以賂蕃之地也。

translations.literal: These three groups—the Tuyuhun, Shatuo, and within Youzhou jurisdiction plus north of Yanmen more than ten prefectures and garrisons' tribal Han troops combine to more than twenty thousand men—this is the territory cut away by Later Shi to bribe the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: These three groups—the Tuyuhun and Shatuo, together with the tribal Han troops of more than ten prefectures and garrisons within Youzhou's jurisdiction and north of Yanmen—combine to more than twenty thousand men. This is the territory that Later Shi cut away to bribe the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 蕃漢諸族，其數可見矣。

translations.literal: The numbers of the various Han and barbarian tribes can thus be seen.
translations.idiomatic: The numbers of the various Han and barbarian tribes can thus be seen.

sentences.zh: 每蕃部南侵，其眾不啻十萬。

translations.literal: Each time the barbarian tribes invade south their hosts are no fewer than one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Each time the barbarian tribes invade south, their hosts are no fewer than one hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 契丹入界之時，步騎車帳不從阡陌，東西一概而行。

translations.literal: When the Khitan enter the border, infantry, cavalry, and carts and tents do not follow the field paths but march uniformly east to west.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan enter the border, infantry, cavalry, carts, and tents do not follow the field paths but march uniformly from east to west.

sentences.zh: 大帳前及東西面，差大首領三人，各率萬騎，支散遊奕，百十里外，亦交相偵邏，謂之欄子馬。

translations.literal: Before the Great Tent and on east and west flanks, three great chiefs are assigned, each leading ten thousand horsemen deployed to scout and patrol; a hundred or ten li out they also watch one another in turn—these are called corral horses.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Great Tent and on the east and west flanks, three great chiefs are assigned, each leading ten thousand horsemen deployed to scout and patrol; a hundred or ten li out they also watch one another in turn—these are called corral horses.

sentences.zh: 契丹主吹角為號，眾即頓合，環繞穹廬，以近及遠。

translations.literal: When the Khitan ruler blows the horn as signal, the masses immediately halt and assemble, encircling the yurts from near to far.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan ruler blows the horn as signal, the masses immediately halt and assemble, encircling the yurts from near to far.

sentences.zh: 折木梢屈之為弓子鋪，不設槍營塹柵之備。

translations.literal: Broken branches are bent into bow-shaped shelters; they set up no pike camps, ditches, or palisade defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Broken branches are bent into bow-shaped shelters; they set up no pike camps, ditches, or palisade defenses.

sentences.zh: 每軍行，聽鼓三伐，不問昏晝，一匝便行。

translations.literal: On each army march, when three beats of the drum are heard, regardless of dusk or dawn, they march one circuit at once.
translations.idiomatic: On each army march, when three beats of the drum are heard, regardless of dusk or dawn, they march one circuit at once.

sentences.zh: 未逢大敵，不乘戰馬，俟近我師，即克乘之，所以新羈戰蹄有餘力也。

translations.literal: Before meeting a major enemy they do not mount war horses; waiting until near our army they then mount—thus newly bridled battle hooves still have surplus strength.
translations.idiomatic: Before meeting a major enemy they do not mount war horses; waiting until they are near our army they then mount—thus newly bridled battle hooves still have surplus strength.

sentences.zh: 且用軍之術，成列而不戰，俟退而乘之，多伏兵斷糧道，冒夜舉火，土風曳柴，饋餉自齎，退敗無恥，散而復聚，寒而益堅，此其所長也。

translations.literal: And their art of using troops: they form ranks without fighting, wait until the enemy retreats then press them; many hidden troops cut supply routes; they kindle fires by night; in local wind they drag brushwood; they carry their own provisions; retreat and defeat bring no shame; scattered they gather again; in cold they grow stronger—these are their strengths.
translations.idiomatic: Their art of war runs thus: they form ranks without fighting, wait until the enemy retreats and then press them; many hidden troops cut supply routes; they kindle fires by night; in local wind they drag brushwood; they carry their own provisions; retreat and defeat bring no shame; scattered they gather again; in cold they grow stronger—these are their strengths.

sentences.zh: 中原所長，秋夏霖霪，天時也；

translations.literal: What the central plains excels at: autumn-summer rains and floods—this is Heaven's season;
translations.idiomatic: What the central plains excels at: autumn and summer rains and floods—this is Heaven's season;

sentences.zh: 山林河津，地利也；

translations.literal: forests, mountains, rivers, and fords—this is terrain's advantage;
translations.idiomatic: forests, mountains, rivers, and fords—this is terrain's advantage;

sentences.zh: 槍突劍弩，兵勝也；

translations.literal: pike charges and sword crossbows—this is military victory;
translations.idiomatic: pike charges and sword crossbows—this is military victory;

sentences.zh: 財豐士眾，力強也。

translations.literal: abundant wealth and numerous warriors—this is strength's fullness.
translations.idiomatic: abundant wealth and numerous warriors—this is strength's fullness.

sentences.zh: 乘時互用，較然可知。

translations.literal: Use each in its season mutually—the comparison can clearly be known.
translations.idiomatic: Use each in its season by turns—the comparison can clearly be known.

sentences.zh: 王師備邊破敵之計，每秋冬時。

translations.literal: The imperial army's plan for border defense and defeating the enemy is each autumn-winter season.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial army's plan for border defense and defeating the enemy applies each autumn and winter.

sentences.zh: 河朔州軍緣邊砦柵，但專守境，勿輒侵漁，令彼尋戈，其詞無措。

translations.literal: The garrison forts along the border of Hebei prefectures and armies need only strictly hold the frontier and not lightly raid—let the enemy go seeking quarrel so their words have no footing.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison forts along the Hebei prefectures and armies need only strictly hold the frontier and not lightly raid—let the enemy go seeking quarrel so their words have no footing.

sentences.zh: 或戎馬既肥，長驅入寇，契丹主行，部落萃至，寒雲翳日，朔雪迷空，鞍馬相持，氈褐之利。

translations.literal: Or when barbarian horses are already fat and they drive deep in invasion, the Khitan ruler moves and the tribes gather; cold clouds shade the sun, northern snow fills the sky; saddle and horse oppose one another—the advantage of felt and coarse wool.
translations.idiomatic: Or when barbarian horses are already fat and they drive deep in invasion, the Khitan ruler moves and the tribes gather; cold clouds shade the sun, northern snow fills the sky; saddle and horse oppose one another—the advantage of felt and coarse wool.

sentences.zh: 所宜守陴坐甲，以逸待勞，令騎士並屯於天雄軍、貝磁相州以來，若分在邊城，緩急難於會合；

translations.literal: What is suitable is to hold the walls and sit in armor, use rest to await exhaustion; have cavalry all garrison from Tianxiong Army and from Bei, Ci, and Xiangzhou onward—for if divided among border cities, urgent need makes assembly difficult;
translations.idiomatic: What is suitable is to hold the walls and sit in armor, using rest to await exhaustion; have cavalry all garrison from Tianxiong Army and from Bei, Ci, and Xiangzhou onward—for if they are divided among border cities, urgent assembly will be difficult;

sentences.zh: 近邊州府，只用步兵，多屯弩手，大者萬卒，小者千人，堅壁固守，勿令出戰。

translations.literal: near-border prefectures use only infantry, station many crossbowmen, large ones ten thousand troops, small ones a thousand, hold the walls firmly and do not allow sorties.
translations.idiomatic: Near-border prefectures should use only infantry and station many crossbowmen—large garrisons ten thousand troops, small ones a thousand—hold the walls firmly and do not allow sorties.

sentences.zh: 彼以全國之兵，此以一郡之眾，雖勇懦之有殊，慮眾寡之不敵也。

translations.literal: They with the whole state's troops, we with one commandery's masses—although brave and cowardly differ, one fears the many and few do not match.
translations.idiomatic: They with the whole state's troops, we with one commandery's masses—although brave and cowardly differ, one fears that many and few will not match.

sentences.zh: 國家別命大將，總統前軍，以遏侵軼，隻於天雄軍、刑洺貝州以來，設掎戎之備。

translations.literal: The state should separately appoint a great general to command the forward army to check invasion and plunder; only from Tianxiong Army and Xing, Mo, and Beizhou onward set preparedness to flank the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The state should separately appoint a great general to command the forward army to check invasion and plunder, and only from Tianxiong Army and Xing, Mo, and Beizhou onward set preparedness to flank the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 俟其陽春啟候，虜計既窮，新草未生，陳荄已朽，蕃馬無力，疲寇思歸，逼而逐之，必自奔北。

translations.literal: Wait until the yang-spring season opens; when the barbarians' plans are exhausted, new grass not yet sprouted, old stubble already rotted, barbarian horses without strength, weary invaders thinking of return—press and pursue them and they will surely flee north themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Wait until the yang-spring season opens; when the barbarians' plans are exhausted, new grass not yet sprouted, old stubble already rotted, barbarian horses without strength, and weary invaders thinking of return—press and pursue them and they will surely flee north on their own.

sentences.zh: 前軍行陣之法，馬步精卒不過十萬，自招討以下，更命三五人藩侯充都監、副戎、排陣、先鋒等職，臨事分布，所貴有權。

translations.literal: The forward army's marching formation method: elite cavalry and infantry not exceeding one hundred thousand; from the recruiting-and-pacifying commissioner downward, further appoint three to five frontier marquises as overall supervisors, deputy commanders, formation arrangers, vanguard, and other posts; distribute at the time of action—what is valued is having authority.
translations.idiomatic: The forward army's marching formation method: elite cavalry and infantry not exceeding one hundred thousand; from the recruiting-and-pacifying commissioner downward, further appoint three to five frontier marquises as overall supervisors, deputy commanders, formation arrangers, vanguard, and other posts; distribute them at the time of action—what is valued is having authority.

sentences.zh: 追戎之陣，須列前後，其前陣萬五千騎，陣身萬人，是四十指揮，左右梢各十指揮，是二十將。

translations.literal: Formation for pursuing barbarians must array front and rear: the front formation fifteen thousand cavalry, formation body ten thousand men—that is forty commanders; left and right wings each ten commanders, that is twenty generals.
translations.idiomatic: Formation for pursuing barbarians must array front and rear: the front formation fifteen thousand cavalry, formation body ten thousand men—that is forty commanders; left and right wings each ten commanders, that is twenty generals.

sentences.zh: 每指揮作一隊，自軍主、都虞候、指揮使、押當，每隊用馬突或刃子槍一百餘，並弓劍、骨朵。

translations.literal: Each commander forms one company—regimental commander, chief aide, commander, standard-bearer—each company uses a hundred-plus horse-chargers or short spears, together with bow, sword, and mace.
translations.idiomatic: Each commander forms one company—regimental commander, chief aide, commander, standard-bearer—each company uses a hundred-plus horse-chargers or short spears, together with bow, sword, and mace.

sentences.zh: 其陣身解鐙排之，俟與戎相搏之時，無問厚薄，十分作氣，槍突交衝，馳逐往來，後陣更進。

translations.literal: The formation body dismounts from stirrups and arrays; when about to grapple with barbarians, regardless of thick or thin, exert full force; pike charges clash; charge and pursue back and forth; the rear formation advances further.
translations.idiomatic: The formation body dismounts from stirrups and arrays; when about to grapple with the barbarians, regardless of thick or thin, exert full force; pike charges clash; charge and pursue back and forth; the rear formation advances further.

sentences.zh: 彼若乘我深入，陣身之後，更有馬步人五千，分為十頭，以撞竿，鐙弩俱進，為回騎之舍。

translations.literal: If they exploit our deep advance, behind the formation body there are further five thousand infantry and cavalry divided into ten heads, using battering poles, all stirrups and crossbows advancing together, as shelter for wheeling cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: If they exploit our deep advance, behind the formation body there are a further five thousand infantry and cavalry divided into ten heads, using battering poles, all stirrups and crossbows advancing together, as shelter for wheeling cavalry.

sentences.zh: 陣哨不可輕動，蓋防橫騎奔衝，此陣以都監主之，進退賞罰，便可裁決。

translations.literal: Formation sentinels must not move lightly—for guarding against horizontal cavalry charges; this formation is supervised by the overall supervisor; advance, retreat, rewards and punishments can be decided on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Formation sentinels must not move lightly—for guarding against horizontal cavalry charges; this formation is supervised by the overall supervisor; advance, retreat, rewards, and punishments can be decided on the spot.

sentences.zh: 後陣以馬步軍八萬，招討董之，與前陣不得過三五里，展梢實心，布常山之勢，左右排陣分押之。

translations.literal: Rear formation with eighty thousand infantry and cavalry, the recruiting commissioner supervises; must not be more than three to five li from front formation; extend wings solid center, lay out the Changshan formation's power, left and right deployed formations separately supervise.
translations.idiomatic: The rear formation comprises eighty thousand infantry and cavalry under the recruiting commissioner; it must not be more than three to five li from the front formation; extend the wings and solidify the center, lay out the Changshan formation's power, and left and right deployed formations supervise separately.

sentences.zh: 或前陣擊破寇兵，後陣亦禁其馳驟輕進，蓋師正之律也。

translations.literal: Or if front formation breaks the invaders, rear formation also forbids reckless galloping advance—for this is the army's discipline law.
translations.idiomatic: Or if the front formation breaks the invaders, the rear formation also forbids reckless galloping advance—for this is the army's discipline.

sentences.zh: 《牧誓》云：“四伐五伐，乃止齊焉。

translations.literal: The "Oath at Mu" says: "Four assaults, five assaults, then stop and align."
translations.idiomatic: The "Oath at Mu" says: "Four assaults, five assaults, then stop and align."

sentences.zh: ”慎重之戒也。

translations.literal: " — a warning of caution.
translations.idiomatic: " — a warning of caution.

sentences.zh: 是以開運中晉軍掎戎，未嘗放散，三四年間，雖德光為戎首，多計桀黠，而無勝晉軍之處，蓋並力禦之。

translations.literal: Therefore in the Kaiyun era Jin army flanked barbarians, never dispersed; within three or four years although Deguang was barbarian chieftain, crafty and cunning in many plots, there was no place he defeated the Jin army—for they combined strength to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore in the Kaiyun era the Jin army flanked the barbarians and never dispersed; within three or four years, although Deguang was the barbarian chieftain, crafty and cunning in many plots, there was no place he defeated the Jin army—for they combined strength to resist.

sentences.zh: 厥後以任人不當，為彥澤之所誤。

translations.literal: After that because personnel were not properly assigned, they were misled by Liu Yanze.
translations.idiomatic: After that, because personnel were not properly assigned, they were misled by Liu Yanze.

sentences.zh: 如將來殺獲驅攘之後，聖人務好生之德，設息兵之謀，雖降志難甘，亦和戎為便。

translations.literal: If in the future after killing, capturing, and driving them off, the sage ruler values the virtue of cherishing life and sets plans to cease arms—even if lowering one's ambition is hard to accept, harmonizing with the barbarians is still convenient.
translations.idiomatic: If in the future, after killing, capturing, and driving them off, the sage ruler values the virtue of cherishing life and sets plans to cease arms—even if lowering one's ambition is hard to accept, harmonizing with the barbarians is still the convenient course.

sentences.zh: 魏絳嘗陳五利，奉春僅得中策，歷觀載籍，前王皆然。

translations.literal: Wei Jiang once set forth five benefits; Feng Chun achieved only the middle strategy; reviewing the records throughout, former kings all did thus.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jiang once set forth five benefits; Feng Chun achieved only the middle strategy; reviewing the records throughout, former kings all did thus.

sentences.zh: 《易》稱高宗用伐鬼方，《詩》美宣王薄伐玁狁，是知戎狄侵軼，其來尚矣。

translations.literal: The Book of Changes praises King Gaozong's campaign against Guifang; the Book of Songs commends King Xuan's light attack on Xianyun—thus one knows barbarian raids have come since long ago.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes praises King Gaozong's campaign against Guifang; the Book of Songs commends King Xuan's light attack on Xianyun—thus one knows that barbarian raids have come since long ago.

sentences.zh: 然則兵為凶器，聖人不得已而用之。

translations.literal: Yet arms are ominous instruments; the sage uses them only when he cannot avoid doing so.
translations.idiomatic: Yet arms are ominous instruments; the sage uses them only when he cannot avoid doing so.

sentences.zh: 若精選使臣，不辱君命，通盟繼好，弭戰息民，此亦策之得也。

translations.literal: If one carefully selects envoys who do not disgrace the ruler's mandate, establish alliance and continue friendship, cease war and rest the people—this too is attaining the strategy.
translations.idiomatic: If one carefully selects envoys who do not disgrace the ruler's mandate, establishes alliance and continues friendship, and ceases war to rest the people—this too is attaining the strategy.

sentences.zh: 臣每見國朝發兵，未至屯戍之所，已於兩河諸郡調民運糧，遠近騷然，煩費十倍。

translations.literal: Your subject each time sees the court dispatch troops—before reaching garrison destinations, already among the Two Rivers prefectures conscript people to transport grain; near and far are disturbed; costs tenfold trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject has often seen the court dispatch troops—before they even reach their garrison destinations, the Two Rivers prefectures are already conscripting people to transport grain; near and far are disturbed, and costs run tenfold.

sentences.zh: 臣生居邊土，習知其事。

translations.literal: Your subject was born and lived on border soil and is familiar with these matters.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject was born and raised on the frontier and is familiar with these matters.

sentences.zh: 況幽州為國北門，押蕃重鎮，養兵數萬，應敵乃其常事。

translations.literal: Moreover Youzhou is the state's northern gate, a heavy fortress holding the barbarians; maintaining troops by the tens of thousands—responding to the enemy is its regular business.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Youzhou is the state's northern gate, a heavy fortress holding the barbarians in check; maintaining troops by the tens of thousands and responding to the enemy is its regular business.

sentences.zh: 每逢調發，惟作糗糧之備，入蕃旬浹，軍糧自齎，每人給麫斗餘，盛之於囊以自隨。

translations.literal: Each time mobilization occurs, only prepare dry grain rations; entering barbarian territory for ten-plus days, army grain self-carried, each man given more than a peck of flour, packed in bags to carry oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Each time mobilization occurs, only dry grain rations need be prepared; entering barbarian territory for ten-plus days, the army carries its own grain, each man given more than a peck of flour packed in bags to carry himself.

sentences.zh: 征馬每匹給生穀二斗，作口袋，飼秣日以二升為限，旬日之間，人馬俱無饑色。

translations.literal: Each campaign horse given two pecks of unhulled grain, made into a feed bag, daily fodder limited to two sheng—for ten days men and horses alike show no sign of hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Each campaign horse is given two pecks of unhulled grain made into a feed bag, with daily fodder limited to two sheng—for ten days men and horses alike show no sign of hunger.

sentences.zh: 更以牙官子弟，戮力津擎裹送，則一月之糧，不煩饋運。

translations.literal: Further using junior officers' sons and younger brothers, exert effort carrying on poles and wrapped delivery—then one month's provisions need not trouble supply transport.
translations.idiomatic: Further, using junior officers' sons and younger brothers to exert themselves carrying supplies on poles and wrapped bundles, one month's provisions need not trouble supply transport.

sentences.zh: 俟大軍既至，定議取舍，然後圖轉餉亦未為晚。

translations.literal: Wait until the great army has arrived, decide what to take and what to leave, then planning relay provisions is also not too late.
translations.idiomatic: Wait until the main army has arrived and decide what to take and what to leave—then planning relay provisions is also not too late.

sentences.zh: 臣去年有平燕之策，入燕之路具在前奏，願加省覽。”

translations.literal: Your subject last year had a strategy for pacifying Yan; the route into Yan is fully set out in the previous memorial—may Your Majesty examine it.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject last year set forth a strategy for pacifying Yan; the route into Yan is fully set out in the previous memorial—may Your Majesty examine it.

sentences.zh: 疏奏，頗采用之。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted, and much of it was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, much of it was adopted.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年，詔百官轉對，琪首應詔，建明堂、辟雍之議。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunhua, an edict ordered all officials to give rotating audiences; Qi was first to respond to the edict and proposed building the Bright Hall and the Piyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunhua, an edict ordered all officials to give rotating audiences. Qi was the first to respond and proposed building the Bright Hall and the Piyong.

sentences.zh: 五年，李繼遷寇靈武，命侍衛馬軍都指揮使李繼隆為河西兵馬都部署以討之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Li Jiqian raided Lingwu; Li Jilong, commander of the Palace Cavalry, was appointed overall commander of Hexi forces to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Li Jiqian raided Lingwu. Li Jilong, commander of the Palace Cavalry, was appointed overall commander of Hexi forces to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 西川賊帥李順攻劫州縣，以昭宣使王繼恩為劍南西川招安使。

translations.literal: The bandit chief Li Shun in western Sichuan attacked and pillaged prefectures and counties; Wang Ji'en, commissioner of imperial messengers, was made pacification commissioner of Jiannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit leader Li Shun in western Sichuan attacked and pillaged prefectures and counties. Wang Ji'en, commissioner of imperial messengers, was appointed pacification commissioner of Jiannan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 琪又上書言邊事曰：
